headline: Sensex and Nifty end flat as high crude oil prices and Fed caution offset sectoral gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Elevated crude oil prices hovering near $115 per barrel weighed heavily on market sentiment.
Uncertainty and caution surrounding upcoming US Fed rate decisions limited upside potential.
Selling pressure in banking and IT stocks dragged benchmark indices down during the session.
Rally in midcap, smallcap, and media stocks helped offset losses in major front-line heavyweights.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty finished largely flat, with Nifty ending below the 22,750 mark.
The Midcap index gained 565 points, while the Media index surged nearly 4%.
The Indian Rupee appreciated marginally by 3 paise to close at 95.12 against the US dollar.
Bajaj Auto posted a 35% increase in Q2 standalone net profit to ₹3,354 crore.
summary:
Indian market benchmarks closed flat as high crude oil prices and Fed rate uncertainty checked gains.
Weakness in banking and IT stocks pressured the market, with Axis Bank and Asian Paints among top losers.
However, broader market strength in midcaps, smallcaps, and media stocks alongside strong Bajaj Auto earnings supported equities.
